tasks.subject: Task 1: still_remove extraction
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One engine-level copy of the still-image detect-to-remove policy + the write tail (`src/core/still_remove.{hpp,cpp}`), callable by CLI, batch, and GUI, with structured outcomes and zero CliOptions dependency.

**Files:**
- Create: src/core/still_remove.hpp, src/core/still_remove.cpp
- Modify: src/cli/cli_app.cpp (:194-309 policy, :420-442 write tail, :52-109 helpers deleted, process_detect :111-179 rewires), src/cli/cli_app.hpp (delete 4 helper decls, add the build_still_remove_options decl), src/cli/batch_processor.cpp, CMakeLists.txt (SOURCES), tests/CMakeLists.txt (LIB_SOURCES)
- Test: tests/unit/still_remove_test.cpp

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- remove_still(WatermarkEngine&, cv::Mat&, const StillRemoveOptions&) -> StillRemoveOutcome {Removed,NoWatermark,Failed; forced/bbox/score/geometry_source/variant/error}; never throws
- write_still_output: JPEG 100 / PNG 6 / WebP 101 + provenance strip; CLI + batch call it; no direct cv::imwrite left in their write paths
- parse_rect + resolve_inpaint_config take StillRemoveOptions; still_remove.* includes no cli/*.hpp, no CLI11
- Glue build_still_remove_options is NON-static, declared in cli_app.hpp, defined above process_detect (which rewires to it, preserving rc-1 on malformed --rect); batch calls the same glue
- wmr_tests links; [still-remove] tests pass (geometry_source asserted as a membership set; fixture run once live and pinned)
- Battery byte-identical (md5 -r + diff, with a fixture-existence guard) vs pre-extraction binary on 2400x1792-test1/2-gemini.png, 896x1200-test4/test3, 1696x2528-gemini38-test1.png, one more 3.8 ref, paintings/fawn.png (noWM: no output, rc 0)
- CLI exit codes unchanged except two DISCLOSED deltas: uppercase-extension outputs get codec params (batch parity); --force now rejects a malformed --rect (rc 1)

**Verify:** ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[still-remove]"; battery per plan Task 1 Step 8.

tasks.subject: Task 3: GUI server + security + browser
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Token-secured 127.0.0.1 server skeleton (pre-routing auth, 1 GiB payload cap, nosniff), image sniff + dimension gate, per-platform browser launch.

**Files:**
- Create: src/gui/security.{hpp,cpp}, src/gui/http_server.{hpp,cpp}, src/gui/browser.{hpp,cpp}, src/gui/image_sniff.{hpp,cpp}
- Test: tests/unit/gui_security_test.cpp, tests/unit/gui_sniff_test.cpp (INSIDE the if(WMR_BUILD_GUI) mirror block, never TEST_SOURCES)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- generate_token(): 32 lowercase hex (platform CSPRNG); host_allowed accepts exactly 127.0.0.1:P / localhost:P / [::1]:P (case-insensitive, one trailing dot) and rejects absent/empty/foreign
- Pre-routing: empty 404 off-token paths; 403 Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site; nosniff on everything; no CORS header ever
- GuiServer binds via bind_to_port when --gui-port is given (failure -> the port-in-use stderr message + rc 1) and via bind_to_any_port for the ephemeral default (its 2nd arg is socket_flags, NOT a port); banner AFTER bind; browser after listen; browser failure non-fatal
- sniff_image: PNG/JPEG/WebP magic + dimensions with LENGTH GUARDS on every read (PNG n>=24; JPEG SOF exactly p+10<=n, not the full segment; WebP chunk tree validated); truncated 10-byte PNG-magic -> Unsupported, no crash; too_large at W*H>120MP or side>16384; HEIC/PDF/0-byte unsupported/empty; JPEG SOF stores height then width (fixture H=200, W=100)
- open_browser: BROWSER env, open/xdg-open (DISPLAY/WAYLAND gated)/ShellExecuteW/WSL wslview; failure non-fatal

**Verify:** ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[gui]"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/gui/security.hpp", "src/gui/security.cpp", "src/gui/http_server.hpp", "src/gui/http_server.cpp", "src/gui/browser.hpp", "src/gui/browser.cpp", "src/gui/image_sniff.hpp", "src/gui/image_sniff.cpp", "tests/unit/gui_security_test.cpp", "tests/unit/gui_sniff_test.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./build/tests/wmr_tests \"[gui]\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["bind_to_port/bind_to_any_port split correct", "sniff length guards + truncated test", "gui tests in mirror block"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: job manager + run dirs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Per-run cache dirs (0700, pid sidecar, dead-pid cleanup), job/file state machines per the spec tables, one serialized worker running remove_still with exception isolation.

**Files:**
- Create: src/gui/run_dir.{hpp,cpp}, src/gui/jobs.{hpp,cpp}
- Test: tests/unit/gui_jobs_test.cpp (mirror block)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- create_run_dir/cleanup_dead_runs take an optional root param (default user_cache_dir()/"gui") so the dead-pid cleanup is unit-testable; a dead-pid sibling is removed, a live one kept; stored_bytes_under(root) recursive size sum; fmt/chrono include + portable getpid block in run_dir.cpp
- Job/file states per spec; done regardless of per-file failures; failed only job-level
- Cancel table exact: queued immediate; running between-files with retention; terminal rejected; unknown 404; first-terminal-wins under mutex
- create_job(files, failed(name,error) entries, opts, max_files, max_bytes, job_id_out): manager persists orig files itself (single owner), renders sniff-rejected entries as terminal failed rows (has_orig=false), fills job_id_out, enforces <=8 pending + job caps + the 4 GiB aggregate gate (payload_too_large)
- file_artifact(id, index, cleaned) is the files endpoint's only path source (nullopt on unknown/missing)
- GuiFile carries forced + has_orig; processor is the worker's member lambda (reused engine_, read_file of the persisted orig); namespace fs alias; per-file try/catch isolation; BOUNDED stop: CV wait_for(5s) on worker-done, std::_Exit(0) on expiry; ~JobManager uses the same bounded path
- IMREAD_COLOR decode; per-file rect bounds check; write_still_output to out/<i>_clean.<ext>

**Verify:** ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[gui-jobs]"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/gui/run_dir.hpp", "src/gui/run_dir.cpp", "src/gui/jobs.hpp", "src/gui/jobs.cpp", "tests/unit/gui_jobs_test.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./build/tests/wmr_tests \"[gui-jobs]\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cancel table + aggregate gate + caps enforced in create_job", "file_artifact + job_id_out + failed-entries contract", "bounded shutdown, per-file isolation"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: REST API + options validation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The complete JSON API per the spec contract: routes, response shapes, error envelope, status codes, pure options validation, sanitized streaming downloads. All cpp-httplib calls use v0.56 names.

**Files:**
- Create: src/gui/options.{hpp,cpp}, src/gui/api.{hpp,cpp}, src/gui/embedded_ui.hpp (EmbeddedUi struct + MIME; empty, UI routes 404 until Task 7)
- Test: tests/unit/gui_options_test.cpp (mirror block)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- validate_job_options: full matrix incl. invalid combos (legacy+rect/preset, force+rect/preset, rect+preset; legacy+force valid), ai-gated denoise, preset vs kStillPresetNames, rect ints x,y>=0 w,h>=8, options part > 64 KB rejected
- Routes: GET / + /app.js + /style.css (CSP on HTML, the corrected 5-directive string WITH connect-src 'self'), /api/version (features + presets from kStillPresetNames), GET /api/jobs (newest first), POST /api/jobs, GET /api/jobs/{id}, POST .../cancel, GET .../files/{i}/image?kind=
- POST: multipart 415 gate; reads req.form (v0.56): get_files("files") in send order + get_field("options") (a part is a field iff filename empty); sniff-rejected files -> (name,error) pairs into create_job (visible rows), POST OK if >=1 valid, zero valid 400; 200 MiB/file + job caps 413; manager codes surface as 429/413; 200 body {"job_id": ...}
- Exact response shapes; one error envelope with the 6 stable codes; {i} via from_chars (404 non-digit/out-of-range); kind=cleaned 404 without has_clean; kind=original 404 without has_orig; downloads via set_file_content(path, mime) + RFC 5987 Content-Disposition (sanitize + _2 collision suffix); mime_for/pct_encode helpers defined in api.cpp

**Verify:** ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[gui-options]"; end-to-end in Task 8.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- wmr gui [--gui-port N] [--no-browser]; early returns skip the WMR_UPDATE_CHECK tail
- No-args always GUI unless WMR_NO_GUI=1 or CI (header+help, exit 0; the help gains exactly one gui subcommand line vs the pre-GUI build - diff accepting that line); --help/--version/parse errors otherwise unchanged; OFF build: no-args help, wmr gui GUI-free message + exit 2
- Shutdown: stop accepting (Server::stop() is noexcept, atomic socket exchange - handler-safe), cancel all, CV wait_for(5s) worker join, remove run dir, exit 0; expiry or second Ctrl-C -> std::_Exit(0) (leftovers die at next start)

tasks.subject: Task 7: embedded web frontend
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The single-page UI (drop/batch, Advanced disclosure, results rows without thumbnails, before/after + bbox overlay, download, offline banner), embedded as three byte arrays with a drift guard.

**Files:**
- Create: assets/gui/{index.html,app.js,style.css}, scripts/embed_gui_assets.py (dev-only), assets/embedded_gui_assets.hpp (generated, committed), src/gui/embedded_ui.cpp
- Modify: src/gui/embedded_ui.hpp (Task 5's stub, filled from the generated header)
- Test: tests/unit/gui_assets_test.cpp (mirror block)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Three sources served at /<token>/, /app.js, /style.css; the corrected 5-directive CSP (WITH connect-src 'self') on HTML; no inline script/style; zero external requests; textContent only
- Drop + Browse, multi-file, NO client-side extension filter (the server sniff renders unsupported files as visible rows); client-side split above caps with a never-empty-chunk guard; rows = filename + badge + actions; Compare dialog with bbox overlay + slider; Download; Cancel
- options(): rect sent only when all four fields are filled (x,y>=0, w,h>=8 client-side grammar; the old $(r[2]) pattern null-derefs); rect/preset disabled under legacy/force
- init() calls refreshJobs() THEN startPolling() (reload recovery re-attaches AND resumes polling; both idempotent)
- Offline rule per spec (persistent banner, controls disabled, no auto-reload)
- Drift-guard test fails when assets/gui/* changes without regeneration

**Verify:** ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[gui-assets]" + manual browser pass (all controls, dark + light, reload mid-job).
